_readme: THE ONE PLACE for prices, passes, trial, language access and Portal Pass credits. The app (src/config/plans.ts) and the payment server (razorpay-create-order / razorpay-verify) both read this file, so the price shown is always the price charged. Amounts are whole rupees (INR); the server converts to paise. After editing: rebuild the app and redeploy the two razorpay functions.
_popular_note: design label only — never a count or a claim. Golden is the recommended main subscription.
_knowledgeLangs_note: PDFs: samples (Free), standard EN (Pro), trilingual (Golden and Platinum). Portal Pass access always includes EN/HI/GU for the unlocked post.

unlocks._note: À-la-carte ₹19/₹9/₹49 is withdrawn — Portal Pass credits replace single-item purchases. Kept in the file only so old receipts still verify. The app hides every buy UI for these SKUs; the server rejects new unlock orders.

_grace_note: paid passes only (not the trial): full access of that tier for N hours, chosen by the LOCAL hour the pass expired
_postPasses_note: Portal Pass CREDIT model. A purchase adds that many credits (unused credits never expire). The member then chooses posts; each unlock spends 1 credit and starts its OWN timer (24h for Single/Triple, 7 days for Universe). Access includes EN/HI/GU, videos, PDFs, photos, HD, download and offline play until that post expires, then it auto-locks. Shown to Free, Pro and Golden. Hidden from Platinum. Website only; hidden in the Android app.

founding.name: THE FIRST 131
founding._note: First 131 verified paid membership purchases get 25% off that membership and later renewals while the eligible subscription stays active (no lapse past grace). Founding Member badge + early-access flag. Counter is the real claimed count from Supabase only — hide or show 0 if there is no backend. Rejoining after a lapse is subject to published terms (discount is not automatic).

referral._note: Personal ?ref=CODE link. Both people get ₹25 wallet credit on the friend's first paid purchase (membership or Portal Pass). Max 5 successful referrals per member. Block self-referral and duplicate accounts (same device hash or email) plus server checks. Wallet can be used at website checkout only.
